item.title: How to Manage Money While Traveling Abroad
item.description: The day-to-day money habits that actually matter on a trip: how to split your funds, avoid the dynamic currency conversion trap, and keep a card working when your primary one doesn't.

item.title: Best Banking Apps for Digital Nomads (2026)
item.description: Wise, Revolut, N26, Charles Schwab Investor Checking, and Chime compared for the specific problems digital nomads run into — foreign fees, ATM access, multi-currency holding, and getting paid across borders.

item.title: How to Budget for Long-Term Travel
item.description: A practical framework for budgeting extended travel — separating one-time setup costs from ongoing daily spending, sizing your buffer, and picking a daily-spend target by region.

item.title: Managing Money as a Digital Nomad: A Practical Starting Guide
item.description: The banking, currency, and tax basics to sort out before you start working from another country — with a real bank-type comparison table and a worked currency-conversion example.
